rationale: Absolute mean signed calibration bias across the grid must be small
Aggregate numerical error target; crossing it triggers review but does not alone reject an estimator
Empirical 95% calibration intervals must not severely undercover
Null positive-signal calls must be approximately calibrated
The estimator must preserve the biological ordering of VMR local genetic control
Null loci must not receive materially positive numerical h2 estimates on average
Mean signed bias must be small across the prespecified low-signal range
No level in the prespecified low-signal range may have excessive mean bias
No simulated h2 level may have gross mean calibration bias, including the upper boundary
